request_summary: Draft two standalone hybrid FDR use cases from the supplied functional rationale, following the repository template and retaining unresolved functional questions.

actions.description: Read the orchestrator persona, session and activity routing, scoped ACE instructions, supplied functional rationale, UC template and AC flow-reference semantics.

Obtained explicit human confirmation to remain on PQ-827-fdr-e2e-test-design and to draft UC-FDR-001 and UC-FDR-002 with unresolved functional questions visible. Preserved pre-existing worktree changes without Git transitions.

Saved docs/use-cases/UC-FDR-001.md and docs/use-cases/UC-FDR-002.md as independent functional drafts, with positive flows, alternatives, exceptions, postconditions, acceptance criteria, open questions and source-ID mappings. Did not author feature files or test code.

Executed static document checks successfully for both saved files: template fields and six ordered sections, nine and six main steps respectively, unique sequential identifiers, twenty acceptance criteria per UC, defined flow/question references, existing local links and explicit not-ready draft status. No test suite or live service was executed.

Applied ppa-readme to the two new UC drafts and read the relevant repository-structure and contribution sections. Assessment: no-update-needed because runtime behaviour, configuration, commands and the existing UC translation workflow remain unchanged.

outcome.detail: Both approved draft documents were persisted and passed the recorded static structure, reference and local-link checks. Functional questions remain open by explicit scope; the drafts are not ready for development. No tests, commit, push or pull request were performed.

notes: Only qa-orchestrator participated. UC authoring was handled as authorized planning documentation, without invoking UC-to-feature skills or creating workflow-run reports. Functional approval and executed-test evidence are not inferred from document checks.
